Maya Khan: Quick sync — onboarding trajectory check-in + deck prep for the mid-May customer QBR. Need slide owners, any renewal-risk flags, and a dry-run. Planning a 20m dry-run Fri 4pm PT. Anyone blocked?
Samir Patel: I can take the onboarding status slide. Will pull latest MAU, seats, and token usage.
Priya Lopez: I’ll own the renewal-risk and exec-ask slide. Can someone share latest contract dates and CSAT? @Maya? :eyes: 
Maya Khan: Uploaded ops sheet and CSAT snapshot to the drive: https://drive.internal/r/abc123 (perm: team/customer-success). Also FYI a customer reported a 3rd-party integration failure yesterday — flagging as medium risk for now.
Liam O'Connor: Noted. I’ll draft a fallback plan slide (short bullets + next steps).
Samir Patel: Adding the usage-to-rev delta slide too — will include a small chart. FYI embedding latency spikes on 2026-03-15 around 02:10 UTC.
Ivy Chen: I can triage the latency spike with eng-platform, but need the run id/log snippet. @Samir or @Maya can you paste the run id?
Maya Khan: Run id is `run-20260315-0210-prod-7f8a`. Pasted logs in the drive folder under /logs/run-7f8a.
Nate (cs-bot): Calendar invite created: Customer QBR dry-run — Fri 16:00 PT. Participants: Maya Khan, Samir Patel, Priya Lopez, Liam O'Connor, Ivy Chen.
Priya Lopez: For the exec ask, I want 3 bullets: 1) pilot extension request 2) custom SLA approval 3) investment for onboarding automation. I’ll draft wording but need cost delta numbers. @Samir can you add the cost slide?
Samir Patel: Yep — cost delta + two scenario modeling (do nothing vs automation). Will have numbers by Thu lunchtime.
Maya Khan: Thanks. Also please add a one-slide "What success looks like" — top 3 metrics + timeline. Liam can you own that?
Liam O'Connor: Yep — will draft the success metrics slide and a one-line onboarding playbook snapshot.
Ivy Chen: I’ll follow up with a short RCA note for the latency spike and propose a mitigations list.
Maya Khan: Action recap (copyable):
```
- Samir: onboarding status + usage chart + cost delta
- Priya: renewal risk + exec ask framing + CSAT callouts
- Liam: success metrics slide + fallback plan
- Ivy: latency triage note
- Maya: assemble deck, final polish, send dry-run invite
```
Maya Khan: Dry-run Fri 4pm PT. Please post blockers here by Thu EOD. I’ll attach the latest deck by Thu 8pm PT. :thumbsup: 
Samir Patel: ack — will post preliminary slides by Thu 11:30 PT.
Priya Lopez: ack, will share exec ask draft by Thu 2pm.
Liam O'Connor: ack.
